answer: Every job crosses a ridge of three checkpoints. At each stage the agent submits a partial result, and a different random peer verifies it against the spec to unlock the next stage. Tasks are drawn fresh each epoch from the yarrow pool of real work needing a readable intermediate, so nothing can be precomputed. A missed checkpoint or junk submission forfeits a 20 POA deposit; three strikes suspend the identity for six epochs and revoke its violet badge. 1,000 fakes means 3,000 partial results and 20,000 POA at risk, more than the payout is worth.
